topic: Former NBA player Mike Miller demonstrates his shooting superiority against a college player at age 40.

hook.first_words: This clip shows the gap between an NBA player and a college hooper.
hook.first_frame: An indoor basketball court with two players facing each other, and a large mural on the back wall.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: THIS CLIP SHOWS THE GAP BETWEEN AN NBA PLAYER AND A COLLEGE HOOPER

shots.shows: Mike Miller shooting over a defender in an indoor gym
Mike Miller dribbling past a defender and shooting a jumper
Mike Miller using a pump fake, fading away, scoring, and trash-talking

ending.last_words: He was still on another level.
ending.last_frame: Mike Miller walking away smiling and talking trash on the basketball court.

script: This clip shows the gap between an NBA player and a college hooper. Mike Miller was already retired and forty years old when a Division 1 player challenged him, probably thinking he had a real chance. But even at forty, Mike showed the same skill that got him into the NBA in the first place. He kept knocking down shot after shot, even catching him with a pump fake before fading away at the basket. And after not missing a shot, he started talking trash and proved he was still on another level.
retention_tricks: continuous high-paced action without dull moments
what_makes_it_work: Unexpected dominance by the older retired player
Engaging narrative arc from challenge to trash talk
